title: onStateChange does not receive page update from infinite hits
body:
## 🐛 Bug description

## 🔍 Bug reproduction

**Steps to reproduce the behavior:**

1. Go to https://codesandbox.io/s/dark-river-27qdw?file=/src/app.js:229-242
2. Click on "show more"
3. See console.log onStateChange was called
4. see that page did not change

**Live reproduction:**

https://codesandbox.io/s/dark-river-27qdw?file=/src/app.js:229-242

## 💭 Expected behavior

page should change, like it does when you don't use `onStateChange`

## Environment

* Version: 4.4.0
